title: Rumble in the Jungle
description: Loose ropes, a spent champion, and a straight right before dawn—Go Deep into Kinshasa, Oct. 30, 1974.
imageHint: Boxing gloves raised high under African lights

questions.question: In Kinshasa on Oct. 30, 1974, which challenger knocked out heavyweight champ George Foreman to reclaim the title?
questions.explanation: Ali was 32 and a heavy underdog. Nearly 60,000 in Stade du 20 Mai chanted him home before dawn.

questions.question: Muhammad Ali's strategy that night—leaning on the ropes and letting Foreman punch himself out—is known as what?
questions.explanation: Angelo Dundee yelled for him to get off the ropes. Ali waved him off: "I know what I'm doing." In the clinches he taunted: "Is that all you got, George?"

questions.question: After rounds of rope-a-dope, in which round did Ali spring off the ropes and put Foreman down for the count?
questions.explanation: A left hook lifted Foreman's chin; a straight right finished it. Counted out at 2:58 of the round. Foreman's first loss in 40 fights.

questions.question: After that eighth-round knockout, the Kinshasa crowd's chant—"Ali, bomaye"—means "Ali," what?
questions.explanation: Lingala for "kill him"—a war cry that became affection. The fight had been delayed after Foreman cut his eye in training; when it finally happened, the city was already chanting.

questions.question: That "kill him" chant night restored a title Ali had lost years earlier for refusing induction into what?
questions.explanation: Stripped in 1967 for refusing the Vietnam draft—"I ain't got no quarrel with them Viet Cong." Kinshasa was the reclaiming, more than seven years later.

deeperMode.title: Go Deeper: Before Kinshasa
deeperMode.description: Olympic gold, a river story, and a parachute on a plane

questions.question: As 18-year-old Cassius Clay, Ali won Olympic light-heavyweight gold at which Games?
questions.hint: He wore an army-surplus parachute on the flight over

questions.question: Which cornerman is credited with coining "float like a butterfly, sting like a bee"?
questions.hint: The chant ended: "Rumble, young man, rumble!"

easterEgg.title: The parachute flight
easterEgg.text: Terrified of flying after a rough trip to the Olympic trials, young Cassius Clay bought an army-surplus parachute and wore it the whole way to Rome. Joe Martin Jr. remembered him praying in the aisle with it on his back.
